newsitem.title: USA: CFTC, New Zealand counterpart ink cooperation pact.
newsitem.headline: CFTC, New Zealand counterpart ink cooperation pact.

text.p: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission said Tuesday it signed a memorandum of understanding with its counterpart in New Zealand that calls for mutual assistance in exchanging regulatory information.
CFTC Chairwoman Brooksley Born signed for the U.S. agency while Chairman Euan Abernethy signed for the New Zealand Securities Commission, the CFTC said.
The memo was signed in Montreal, where both officials are attending the annual meeting of of the International Organization of Securities Commissions, the CFTC said.

Under the memo, each agency, when requested, will give the other access to information in its files, take testimony and statements, obtain information and documents and conduct compliance inspections or examinations of futures transactions and businesses.
